verdict.rationale: No evidence documents retention periods or deletion controls. Users get indirect control over their data: they can self-host the product via Docker, so the data sits on their own infrastructure. They can limit what is sent with tracesSampleRate, and the hosted service offers a separate EU instance for data residency. Missing for 10: a documented retention window, per-project or per-org retention policies, deletion of events, issues or projects, account and data erasure on the hosted service, and independent confirmation of any of these.
